description: "Off-Nominal" is an engineering and data science crew tackling NASA's Flame in Freefall challenge. we synthesize decades of ISS microgravity fire experiments-From spherical cool flames to solid fuel ignition-into an intelligent, high-speed dashboard designed to keep future orbital, lunar and Martian habitats safe when conditions go off-nominal.
summary: Field Shift is a project from the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It is a dashboard that looks at soil health. The dashboard gives recommendations for crop rotation based on data. It uses Python and FastAPI. It also uses the Google Earth Engine SDK. The system brings in data, from Landsat 9. It gets surface reflectance data. It also uses SMAP soil moisture data. It adds SRTM elevation data.. It uses NASA POWER and Open-Meteo for weather information. There is a Leaflet map. Farmers can use the map to look at areas of their farm. They can check in time. They can look at NDVI vegetation measurements. They can compare plots. They can find the best crops to grow.
details: Field Shift is an agricultural dashboard designed to help farmers improve their crop yields and support sustainable farming. The tool evaluates soil health. Creates smart crop rotation plans based on real-time data. Farmers can choose plots on a map built with Leaflet. When they select a plot the system runs an analysis using a Python and FastAPI backend. The system pulls satellite images and weather data from the Google Earth Engine SDK and Open-Meteo APIs. It calculates vegetation health compares parts of the farm and suggests the best crops, for each area. All recommendations are made based on soil conditions and climate patterns. The goal is to help farmers make decisions and grow more with less environmental impact.
